name: proof-jev
description: Review a change, find what the tests miss, and try the app in a real browser. Uses Jev for optional code review.

interface.longDescription: Check your changes before you ship. Review code with Jev, challenge your tests with small deliberate bugs, and verify local app behavior in a real browser. Open the report to see exactly what happened.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my tests would catch bugs in this change.
Review my changes and investigate anything risky.
Try my local app and check that it really saves.
Set up Proof-Jev for this project.
